advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a pacing test with elapsed in [900,1800) (e.g. PASS_STARTED_EPOCH = now-1200) asserting the recorded sleep is capped at 900.
evidence: test_pacing_sleeps_for_the_passs_own_elapsed_duration uses started = int(time.time()) - 100 and asserts 100 <= slept[0] <= 130
ABSENCE: no test sets PASS_STARTED_EPOCH to an elapsed value in [900,1800), so the cap-to-900 branch is never taken
advisory.finding: The 900-second sleep cap in the pacing block is never exercised: the sleeping-branch test uses a ~100s pass (well under the cap) and the skip test uses 2000s (>=1800, no sleep), so no test drives an elapsed value in the [900,1800) window where the cap applies. A regression removing `[ "${pause}" -gt 900 ] && pause=900` (allowing a sleep up to ~1799s) — the exact runner-timeout-budget hazard the change cites — would pass all current tests.
advisory.suggested_fix:
def test_pacing_sleep_is_capped_at_900s(tmp_path):
    started = int(time.time()) - 1200
    completed = _run_redispatch(tmp_path, _DISPATCH_OK, {"PASS_STARTED_EPOCH": str(started)})
    assert completed.returncode == 0
    assert _slept(tmp_path) == [900]

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a pacing test with a non-numeric PASS_STARTED_EPOCH asserting exit 0, no sleep, and the 'chain pacing skipped' note.
evidence: test_pacing_is_skipped_when_the_pass_start_stamp_is_missing calls _run_redispatch(tmp_path, _DISPATCH_OK) with no PASS_STARTED_EPOCH — the unset path only
ticket f59a-2d16-68c5-450c AC: 'skipped when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is unset or non-numeric ... tests assert ... the unset-guard branch' names only the unset branch
ABSENCE: no test sets PASS_STARTED_EPOCH to a non-numeric value (e.g. 'abc') to exercise the digits-only guard
advisory.finding: The pacing guard is documented and specified (ticket AC) to skip when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is unset OR non-numeric, and the shell uses `grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'` to enforce both. Only the *unset* case is tested (test_pacing_is_skipped_when_the_pass_start_stamp_is_missing sets no env var). A non-numeric value is a distinct regression path: narrowing the guard to a non-empty check would keep the unset test green but let arithmetic run on a non-numeric string under `set -euo pipefail`, aborting the whole re-dispatch step.
advisory.suggested_fix:
def test_pacing_is_skipped_when_the_stamp_is_non_numeric(tmp_path):
    completed = _run_redispatch(tmp_path, _DISPATCH_OK, {"PASS_STARTED_EPOCH": "not-a-number"})
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stdout + completed.stderr
    assert _slept(tmp_path) == []
    assert "chain pacing skipped" in completed.stdout
